policy: Append-only. An id is never reused and never reassigned. A rename or reparent appends the new route key to the existing record; retirement sets `retired` and keeps the record forever. Run `bun run ids:mint` to allocate ids for new corpus concepts; rebinding a moved concept is an editorial act and is never done automatically.
